http://hl7.org/fhir/diagnostic-report-status  appendedAppendedSubsequent to being final, the report has been modified by adding new content. The existing content is unchanged.

http://hl7.org/fhir/diagnostic-report-status  unknownUnknownThe authoring/source system does not know which of the status values currently applies for this observation. Note: This concept is not to be used for "other" - one of the listed statuses is presumed to apply, but the authoring/source system does not know which.

Expansion performed internally based on codesystem ObservationStatus v4.0.1 (CodeSystem)

This value set contains 7 concepts

SystemCodeDisplay (en)DefinitionJSONXML
http://hl7.org/fhir/observation-status  registeredRegistered

The existence of the observation is registered, but there is no result yet available.

http://hl7.org/fhir/observation-status  preliminaryPreliminary

This is an initial or interim observation: data may be incomplete or unverified.

http://hl7.org/fhir/observation-status  finalFinal

The observation is complete and there are no further actions needed. Additional information such "released", "signed", etc would be represented using Provenance which provides not only the act but also the actors and dates and other related data. These act states would be associated with an observation status of preliminary until they are all completed and then a status of final would be applied.

http://hl7.org/fhir/observation-status  amendedAmended

Subsequent to being Final, the observation has been modified subsequent. This includes updates/new information and corrections.

http://hl7.org/fhir/observation-status  correctedCorrected

Subsequent to being Final, the observation has been modified to correct an error in the test result.

http://hl7.org/fhir/observation-status  cancelledCancelled

The observation is unavailable because the measurement was not started or not completed (also sometimes called "aborted").

http://hl7.org/fhir/observation-status  unknownUnknown

The authoring/source system does not know which of the status values currently applies for this observation. Note: This concept is not to be used for "other" - one of the listed statuses is presumed to apply, but the authoring/source system does not know which.
